title: [review] project-LICHEN-2auf.44.11.1.1: test suite doesn't compile (26 errors)
description:
## Summary
`cargo test -p lichen-oscore` fails with 26 compilation errors across:
- `tests/vectors.rs` (10 errors): `restore_existing` signature mismatch (old 6-arg call sites not updated), `protect_request` no longer exists on `Context`, `Context::new` changed from 4 to 5 args, duplicate `#[test]` attribute
- `src/lib.rs` test module (16 errors): `Option<OscoreSeqNum>` changed to `OscoreSeqNum` breaking `fetch_increment`/`increment`/`encode_piv`/`get` calls, `restore_existing` signature mismatch, mismatched types
